Container.Name: Lineup
Container.Overview: Lineup provides a web dashboard for HDHomeRun discovery and proxying, live TV streaming, scheduled EPG collection, and XMLTV output for media servers such as Jellyfin and Plex. BREAKING 2.0 HOST LAYOUT: before starting Lineup 2.0, existing users must move or copy the contents of their prior Lineup appdata directory (whether its container target was /config or /appdata) into /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/data, or explicitly change this template's Appdata host path to retain their existing directory. Otherwise, Lineup starts as a new installation. HTTPS certificates remain separate under /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/certs and must not be moved into the data directory.
Container.Changes:
### 2026-09-17 - Updated the template for Lineup 2.0.0. - BREAKING HOST LAYOUT: Appdata now defaults to /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/data on the host and maps to /appdata in the container. - BEFORE STARTING 2.0: existing users must move or copy their prior Lineup appdata contents (whether previously mapped to /config or /appdata) into /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/data, or explicitly retain their existing Appdata host-path mapping. Otherwise, Lineup starts as a new installation. - HTTPS certificates remain in the separate /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/certs directory and must not be moved into the data directory. - Added the HDHomeRun discovery/proxy and SSDP UDP port mappings. - Added read-only HTTPS certificate directory, optional certificate password, and optional OpenTelemetry settings.
### 2026-02-25 - Initial release

Config.Name: Web Interface (HTTP)
Config.Description: Host port mapped to Lineup's HTTP listener on TCP port 8080.

Config.Name: Web Interface (HTTPS)
Config.Description: Optional host port mapped to Lineup's HTTPS listener on TCP port 8443. HTTPS must be configured in Lineup.

Config.Name: HDHomeRun Discovery / Proxy
Config.Description: Optional UDP port used for HDHomeRun discovery and proxy traffic.

Config.Name: SSDP Discovery
Config.Description: Optional UDP port used for SSDP discovery traffic.

Config.Name: Appdata
Config.Description: Persistent Lineup settings, database, and other application-owned state. BREAKING 2.0 MIGRATION: before starting 2.0, move or copy the contents of your prior Lineup appdata directory (whether previously mapped to /config or /appdata) into /mnt/user/appdata/lineup/data, or explicitly retain your existing host path here. Otherwise, Lineup starts as a new installation. Keep HTTPS certificates in the separate certificate directory; do not move them into this data directory.

Config.Name: XMLTV Output
Config.Description: Host path where Lineup stores generated XMLTV output.

Config.Name: HTTPS Certificate Directory
Config.Description: Host directory containing the HTTPS certificate named lineup.pfx. The certificate is available in the container at /app/certs/lineup.pfx.

Config.Name: HTTPS Certificate Password
Config.Description: Optional password for lineup.pfx. Leave blank when using a passwordless PFX certificate.

Config.Name: OpenTelemetry Endpoint
Config.Description: Optional OTLP endpoint. Leave blank to disable OpenTelemetry export.

Config.Name: OpenTelemetry Protocol
Config.Description: OTLP transport protocol. Supported values are httpProtobuf and grpc.

Config.Name: Variable: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for the running container

Config.Name: Variable: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for the running container
